display.label: AWS VPC
display.description: Provision Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) networks with DNS, IPv6, and tenancy settings

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique name and identifier for the VPC, applied as the 'Name' tag.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core VPC settings including name, primary IPv4 CIDR block, and instance tenancy.

fields.label: VPC Name
fields.description: Unique name for the VPC, applied as the 'Name' tag and map key.

validation.pattern_error: VPC name must only contain alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

fields.label: IPv4 CIDR Block
fields.description: The primary IPv4 network range for the VPC in CIDR notation (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16).

validation.pattern_error: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16).

fields.label: Instance Tenancy
fields.description: Tenancy option for instances launched into the VPC.

sections.label: DNS Settings
sections.description: Configure Amazon DNS resolution and private/public DNS hostnames for EC2 instances.

fields.label: Enable DNS Resolution
fields.description: Whether to enable DNS resolution support through the Amazon provided DNS server.

fields.label: Enable DNS Hostnames
fields.description: Whether instances launched in the VPC get public DNS hostnames (requires DNS resolution enabled).

sections.label: IPv6 Settings
sections.description: Configure IPv6 address allocation and network border groups.

fields.label: Auto-assign Amazon IPv6 CIDR Block
fields.description: Requests an Amazon-provided IPv6 CIDR block with a /56 prefix length.

fields.label: Network Border Group
fields.description: Restrict advertisement of public IPv6 addresses to specific Network Border Groups (e.g., Local Zones).

sections.label: Metrics & Monitoring
sections.description: Configure CloudWatch metrics for network address usage.

fields.label: Enable Network Address Usage (NAU) Metrics
fields.description: Whether to enable Network Address Usage metrics to monitor IP address capacity in your VPC.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for organizational and cost allocation purposes.

fields.label: VPC Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to the VPC.
